wuh-sat-1.webp.zh: 从卫星图看，武汉天河国际机场（WUH）的机场布局与周边环境清晰可辨。
wuh-sat-1.webp.en: In the satellite image, the layout of Wuhan Tianhe International Airport (WUH) and its surroundings are clearly visible.

wuh-baidu-1.webp.zh: 武汉天河国际机场航站楼前：海南航空客机停在机坪上，屋顶写着「WUHAN TIANHE AIRPORT」。
wuh-baidu-1.webp.en: A Hainan Airlines jet on the apron in front of Wuhan Tianhe's terminal, whose roof reads "WUHAN TIANHE AIRPORT".

wuh-baidu-2.webp.zh: 从舷窗看武汉天河国际机场：国航客机停在廊桥旁，航站楼屋脊上写着「武汉」，远处是喇叭形塔台。
wuh-baidu-2.webp.en: From a cabin window at Wuhan Tianhe — an Air China jet at the gate, the characters for Wuhan on the terminal roof, and the flared control tower beyond.
